description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510810
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
